A '''Pyke''' operated under the [[Pyke Syndicate]] during the early [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of [[The Bad Batch Season 1|''The Bad Batch'' Season 1]] in [[19 BBY]].</ref> the Pyke Syndicate made deals with the [[Durand crime family]].<ref name="Infested" /> After [[Roland Durand]] lost his [[spice]] to [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] and [[Clone Force 99]], this [[Pyke]] held him hostage in [[Cid's Parlor]] on [[Ord Mantell]]. After meeting Clone Force 99, the Pyke made a deal where he kept the [[Omega|kid]] while the rest of the force obtained the missing spice. Once the spice was delivered, the Pyke then cut off one of Roland Durand's horns and thanked them all for doing business with them.<ref name="Infested" /> Sometime later, the Pyke would be captured by two members of Clone Force 99; [[Wrecker]] and [[Hunter]], who delivered the Pyke to [[Devaron]] in exchange for information from Roland Durand's mother, [[Isa Durand]].<ref name="Paths Unknown">{{TBB|Paths Unknown}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This Pyke first appeared in "[[Infested]]," the thirteenth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''. He was voiced by [[Liam O'Brien]].<ref name="Infested" />
